## Purpose

Step 4 combines the CVD Step 3 count input with a completed mortality release.
It calculates and privately stages hospital-only burden results, annual
hospital-plus-DCO rates, and the private DCO component evidence used by Step 5.
It does not review, approve or publish.

## Required inputs

| Input | Location |
|---|---|
| Step 3 count data and receipt | `$BNR_DATA_DERIVED/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/metric_inputs/` |
| Completed mortality-linked CVD calculations | `$BNR_PRIVATE/data/derived/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/linkage/mort_yYYYY_mMM/` |

## Run

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do" 2024 4 2026 7
```

Use `replace` only to deliberately rebuild the same CVD release.

## Output and checks

The private staging package is:

`$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_YYYY_MM/`

Inspect its `datasets/`, `metadata/` and `review/` folders and confirm the
controller reports successful combined calculation and staging. Do not alter
generated products by hand. The following Step 5 preparation supplies the
human review workbook and disclosure QA.

Annual DCO-facing public-shaped rows are limited to All CVD, Heart and Stroke;
all, female and male; and Primary/Inclusive definitions. Additional-DCO counts
are annual and all-age only; component accounting remains private.
